summary: BI-92804832 (EP-5F6369AB). Migration 20261113140000_retire_roleless_ea_self_associations retires role-less associated_with EA relationships that join an element to itself, with their ASSOCIATED_WITH graph projection. An association needs a role naming what it means (BI-E487F6D9); a role-less self-association names nothing and has no typed reading to retype to. Associations between two different elements are left for their owners to qualify.
affectedCopies: EaRelationship: role-less associated_with rows whose source and target element are the same are deleted
graph_edge: the ASSOCIATED_WITH edge projecting each retired row is deleted

privacyAssessment.reviewDisposition: Only role-less self-links with empty properties are affected; no element or other relationship changes.
